detail.longDescription:
I just published node-build-stream: a zero-dep, Node 24+ streaming build runner replacing Gulp's core, compatible with existing Gulp plugins — ~20% faster than gulp.

Vite follows a module graph from entry files; this is file-stream oriented: process arbitrary files anywhere, no entry point required. Batch-optimize an SVG folder, automate uploads/webhooks, concat legacy global scripts sans module sandboxing, fan one source into many outputs.

Full TS types, docs, AI agent support. MIT.

#webdev
